intro.text: Welcome to the waiting workout! Every wait makes your waiting muscle stronger.

praise.text: Rep complete! Your waiting muscle just got stronger.

cheer.text: Waiting workout complete! You are a self-control champion!

praise.text: Great waiting rep! Your muscle is growing.

cheer.text: You used three waiting tricks and got stronger!

say.text: Place one small treat or favorite toy where you can see it.
Ten-second wait! Put your hands on your knees and make them strong and still.

after.text: Ten seconds! Your waiting muscle did its first rep.

say.text: Twenty-second wait! Look away from the treat and count slowly in your head.

after.text: Twenty seconds! The look-away trick made waiting easier.

say.text: Thirty-second wait! Sing a favorite song inside your head.

after.text: Thirty seconds! Your waiting muscle is powerful.

say.text: EAT or PLAY — you earned it, champion! And the bigger win is this: you just got stronger.

praise.text: Master rep complete! Your muscle is GROWING.

cheer.text: You made a strong choice! Taking it now or waiting again can both be celebrated.

say.text: The one-minute grand wait begins! Choose your best waiting trick for the first fifteen seconds.

after.text: Fifteen seconds! Your muscle is GROWING.

say.text: Keep going for fifteen more seconds. Sit on your hands or keep them strong on your knees.

after.text: Thirty seconds! Your muscle is GROWING. You are halfway, Waiting Master.

say.text: Fifteen more seconds. Look away and count slowly in your head.

after.text: Forty-five seconds! Your muscle is GROWING.

say.text: Final fifteen seconds! Sing inside your head all the way to the finish.

after.text: One whole minute! Your waiting muscle is stronger than ever.

say.text: Now choose: enjoy the treat, or wait again to make it two. Both choices are strong choices.
You chose for yourself! Celebrate your strong waiting muscle!
